I read the whole file. It introduces only two new definitions, `RVM.EquationsBefore` and `RVM.ClassicalBefore`. Everything else is a lemma or theorem, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication.

- `EquationsBefore` is the Vlasov–Maxwell system on a time interval, written with one-sided `derivWithin` at t = 0. It also uses project-specific `spatialPartial`, `curl`, `divergence`, `rho`, `current`, `cross`, `velocity` and `Solution`. These are defined in other files, not here. Mathlib has no equivalent of this specific PDE system.
- `ClassicalBefore` is a conjunction of regularity hypotheses, positivity, `EquationsBefore` and the initial data. It is domain-specific and does not compete with any Mathlib concept.
- The `PiLp.proj` and `ContinuousLinearMap` uses in the proofs reuse Mathlib. The `crossCLM`, `dirD` and `divergence` operators they call are defined in other project files, outside the scope of this file. I did not check those files for overlap with Mathlib.

I found no justified competing-concept finding. I did not run a Mathlib search for `divergence` or `curl`, because those declarations are not in this file.
